scope: F2 fold-0 screen. New feature block: explicit low-rank pairwise interactions among the 13 service ratings (rank R=8). Captures rating × rating synergy beyond additive effects.

H57_LOWRANK_INTERACTIONS.question: Do explicit low-rank pairwise interaction features among the 13 service ratings improve fold-0 OOF AUC when added to the 21-raw base?
H57_LOWRANK_INTERACTIONS.method: For each of the 13 ratings, compute low-rank pairwise interactions via SVD: rating matrix R (n×13) → U (n×8) V^T (8×13). Use cross-fit SVD: fit SVD on folds 1-4, project fold-0. Add 8 latent dimensions as features. LGBM on 21raw+8lowrank vs 21raw, fold-0.
H57_LOWRANK_INTERACTIONS.leakage: SVD fit on FIT only (folds 1-4), project fold-0. No satisfaction label in SVD. Fold-safe.
H57_LOWRANK_INTERACTIONS.decision_rule: PROMISING if fold-0 port_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995.
